blocks.text: Coulomb ka qanoon electrostatics ka bunyadi usool hai jo do charged ajsaam ke darmiyan force ko miqdar mein bayan karta hai. Electric charges ke darmiyan force ki pehli paimaish (measurement) French physicist Charles de Coulomb ne ki (print mein saal 1874 likha hai, jo 1806 mein un ki wafat ke baad hai; Coulomb ne apni paimaishein 1785 mein shaya kin). Coulomb ka qanoon charged zarron ke rawayye aur bohat se electrical mazahir ko chalane wale taamulat samajhne ke liye lazmi hai. In paimaishon ki bunyad par unhon ne ek qanoon nikala jo Coulomb ka qanoon kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Coulomb ka qanoon
blocks.text: Do nuqtai (point) charges ke darmiyan force charges ki miqdaron ke hasil-e-zarb ke seedhe tanasub mein aur un ke darmiyani faasle ke murabbe ke ulat tanasub mein hai: F, q1 q2 / r^2 ke tanasub mein, ya F = k q1 q2 / r^2 ... (9.1).

Yahan F woh mushtarka (mutual) force hai jo dono nuqtai charges q1 aur q2 mein se har ek par lagti hai, aur r un ka darmiyani faasla hai. Force F hamesha dono nuqtai charges ko milane wali lakeer ke saath lagti hai (Fig. 9.1): milte jhulte charges ek doosre ko dhakelte (repel) aur mukhtalif charges khainchte (attract) hain. k tanasub ka constant hai; is ki qeemat dono charges ke darmiyan medium ki fitrat aur us units ke nizam par munhasir hai jis mein F, q aur r nape jayein. Agar dono nuqtai charges ke darmiyan khali space (free space) ho aur units ka nizam SI ho to k = 1/(4 pi eps0) ... (9.2), jahan eps0 ek electrical constant hai jise free space ki permittivity kehte hain; SI units mein is ki qeemat 8.85 x 10^-12 C^2 N^-1 m^-2 hai. eps0 ki qeemat rakhne par k = 1/(4 pi eps0) = 9 x 10^9 N m^2 C^-2. Yun free space mein Coulomb ki force F = (1/(4 pi eps0)) q1 q2 / r^2 ... (9.3) hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (a) Do narangi charges +q1 aur +q2, faasla r; q1 par force F12 baen taraf, q2 par F21 daen taraf, yani ek doosre se door. (b) Narangi +q1 aur neela -q2, faasla r; q1 par F12 daen aur q2 par F21 baen, yani ek doosre ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.1: (a) aik jaise charges mein dafa (repulsion) ki forces aur (b) mukhalif charges mein kashish (attraction) ki forces (kitab ki Figure 9.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono halaton mein forces charges ko milane wali lakeer ke saath hain aur barabar magar ulat hain (F12 = -F21). Aik jaise charges ek doosre ko dhakelte hain, mukhalif charges kheenchte hain.

Agar q1, q2 par force lagaye to q2 bhi q1 par barabar aur ulat force lagata hai. Agar q1 ki q2 par force F21 aur q2 ki q1 par force F12 likhein to F12 = -F21 ... (9.4). Dono forces ki miqdar ek hai aur Eq. 9.3 se milti hai. In ki simt dikhane ke liye unit vectors istemal karte hain: agar r21 (hat) q1 se q2 ki taraf aur r12 (hat) q2 se q1 ki taraf unit vector ho to F21 = (1/(4 pi eps0)) (q1 q2 / r^2) r21 (hat) ... (9.5) aur F12 = (1/(4 pi eps0)) (q1 q2 / r^2) r12 (hat) ... (9.6) (Fig. 9.2). Chunke r21 (hat) = -r12 (hat), yeh equations dikhati hain ke F21 = -F12. Charges ki alamaat (signs) tay karti hain ke forces kashish ki hain ya dafa (repulsion) ki.

blocks.alt: Do tirchhe hisse. (a) q1 (neeche baen) aur q2 (oopar daen), faasla r; q2 par surkh teer F21 q1 se door, saath chhota siyah unit vector r21 (hat) usi simt mein. (b) q1 par surkh teer F12 q2 se door, saath unit vector r12 (hat).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2 (kitab ki Figure 9.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Unit vector r21 (hat) q1 se q2 ki taraf hai aur r12 (hat) q2 se q1 ki taraf, is liye r21 = -r12. Yahan dono charges aik jaise hain, is liye har force doosre charge se door hai aur F21 = -F12.

Agar dono charges ke darmiyan medium insulator ho to use aam taur par dielectric kehte hain. Dielectric ki maujoodgi electrostatic force ko free space ke muqable hamesha ek khaas factor se kam kar deti hai jo diye gaye dielectric ke liye constant hai. Is constant ko relative permittivity kehte hain aur eps_r se zahir karte hain. Yun eps_r relative permittivity wale medium mein Coulomb ki force F = (1/(4 pi eps0 eps_r)) q1 q2 / r^2 ... (9.7) hai. Hawa ke liye eps_r 1.0006 hai, jo ek ke itna qareeb hai ke na-qabil-e-zikr ghalti ke saath Eq. 9.3 hawa mein electric force deti hai.

blocks.caption: Table 9.1: relative permittivity eps_r (qeematein coverage note ke mutabiq tarteeb di gayin)

blocks.title: Example 9.1
blocks.text: Teen nuqtai charges q1 = +40 uC, q2 = -60 uC aur q3 = -50 uC ek satah mein hain: q2, q1 se 0.15 m door hai, aur q3, q1 se 0.12 m door q1q2 ke saath 60 degrees wali lakeer par hai (Fig. 9.2a). q1 par khalis force nikalein. Hal: F12 = k q1 q2 / r^2 = (9 x 10^9)(40 x 10^-6)(60 x 10^-6)/(0.15)^2 = 960 N, kashish, q1q2 ke saath. F13 = (9 x 10^9)(40 x 10^-6)(50 x 10^-6)/(0.12)^2 = 1250 N, kashish, 60 degrees par. Ajza: F13x = 1250 cos 60 = 625 N, F13y = 1250 sin 60 = 1075 N. Fx = 960 + 625 = 1585 N, Fy = 1075 N. F = sqrt(Fx^2 + Fy^2) = 1915 N (print mein 1975 N). tan theta = 1075/1585 = 0.68, theta = q1 aur q2 ko milane wali lakeer se 34 degrees.

blocks.alt: Example 9.1: kone par q1 = +40 microcoulomb; ufuqi lakeer par r2 = 0.15 m par q2 = -60 microcoulomb; 60 degree wali lakeer par r3 = 0.12 m par q3 = -50 microcoulomb. q1 se magenta teer F2 aur F3 q2 aur q3 ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2(a) (kitab ki Figure 9.2(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Dashed axes x'-x aur y'-y par free-body diagram. F2 +x ki taraf. F3 60 degree par oopar daen; us ke hisse F3 cos 60 (x par) aur F3 sin 60 (y par) teeron se, dashed lakeerein mustateel poora karti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2(b) (kitab ki Figure 9.2(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: q2 aur q3 dono manfi hain aur q1 musbat, is liye q1 par dono forces kashish ki hain: F2 q2 ki taraf aur F3 q3 ki taraf. F3 ke hisse jod kar Fx = 960 + 625 = 1585 N aur Fy = 1075 N. Kitab F = 1975 N likhti hai; durust jawab under-root(1585^2 + 1075^2) = 1915 N hai.

Van de Graaff generator ek electrostatic generator hai jo chalti belt se insulated sutoon (column) ke oopar khokhle dhaati gole par electric charge jama karta hai, aur kam current par bohat zyada voltage wala direct current banata hai. Ise American physicist Robert J. Van de Graaff ne 1929 mein ijad kiya. Jadeed Van de Graaff generators 5 megavolts tak pohanch sakte hain, aur mez par rakhne wala version taqreeban 100 000 volts aur nazar aane wali chingari ke liye kaafi energy deta hai. Ek pulley insulating belt ko aisi tez nok wali dhaati kanghi (comb) ke paas se chalati hai jise power supply ne musbat charge diya ho; belt se electrons nikal jate hain aur woh musbat charged reh jati hai, aur oopar wali waisi hi kanghi khalis musbat charge ko gumbad (dome) par phailne deti hai (Do You Know).

blocks.prompt: Do nuqtai charges 10 m door hain; faasla 5 m karne par force ka kya hota hai (MCQ 9.1)? Do charges 5.0 cm par 0.4 N se dhakelte hain; 2.5 cm aur 15.0 cm par force nikalein (numerical 9.1). Kya charged aur be-charge jism ke darmiyan electrostatic force hoti hai (Point to ponder)?
blocks.explanation: F, 1/r^2 ke tanasub mein hai, to r aadha karne se force chaar guna hoti hai, option (d). 2.5 cm par faasla aadha hai: F = 4 x 0.4 = 1.6 N; 15.0 cm par teen guna: F = 0.4/9 = 0.044 N (print mein 0.04 N). Haan: charged jism be-charge jism ke mukhalif charges ko qareeb khainchta aur milte jhulte charges ko door dhakelta hai, to qareeb wale mukhalif charges zyada zor se khinchte hain; isi liye charged kanghi kaghaz ke tukre utha leti hai.

items: Coulomb ka qanoon: F = k q1 q2 / r^2 (9.1) charges ko milane wali lakeer ke saath; k = 1/(4 pi eps0) = 9 x 10^9 N m^2 C^-2, eps0 = 8.85 x 10^-12 C^2 N^-1 m^-2; milte jhulte dhakelte, mukhalif khainchte hain; F12 = -F21 (9.4); vector shaklein (9.5), (9.6).
Dielectric force ko apni relative permittivity eps_r se kam karta hai (9.7); hawa 1.0006, pani 78.5. Example 9.1: 960 N aur 1250 N mil kar 34 degrees par 1915 N.
